Requirements Your waking world is active.

The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC. The creature must be Medium or smaller; if your waking world is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20], the creature can be Large or smaller, or Huge or smaller if your waking world is a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] or larger. If you use this ability while your waking world already has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Grabbed] or devoured, that creature is automatically freed. If your waking world ends, any creature affected by this ability is automatically freed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[3d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage and is grabbed by the earth. The creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled into the earth, which closes above it. It takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage immediately and is devoured. While devoured, it becomes grabbed and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1}, and takes @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage at the end of each of its turns, and cannot be targeted by any effect. A creature can attempt to Escape against your world rouser DC; in addition to the normal checks to Escape, it can attempt a Nature check. If it Escapes, it is returned to the area where it was when grabbed. A creature with a burrow Speed can Escape automatically and move up to its burrow Speed as part of that action.
